QuestInfo.name: Ancient Dragon Wing Scales
QuestInfo.0: Go obtain #bAncient Dragon Wing Scales#k from #bChief Tatamo.
QuestInfo.1: #bChief Tatamo#k says he'll give you the #bAncient Dragon Wing Scales#k if you donate #b50 million mesos#k to the town of Leafre.
QuestInfo.2: You got the #bAncient Dragon Wing Scales#k from #bChief Tatamo#k!

0.0: You're looking for Ancient Dragon Wing Scales? Well, of course, I have some.
0.1: However, they are rare and precious. You must pay a great price if you wish to have them. Are you still interested?

yes.0: Very well. If you donate 50 million mesos to Leafre, I will give you the scales.

no.0: Ah, I understand. If you change your mind, let me know.

1.0: Do you have the 50 million mesos to donate?

yes.0: Then please, take the Ancient Dragon Wing Scales. Your donation will be put to good use.

item.0: Ah, you still do not have the 50 million meso donation, do you?
